metadata.title: Foundation AstroJev Spatial Hold-Out Validation & Coordinate Invariance Audit

findings: Transfer accuracy between Galactic North (train) and Galactic South (test) is 55.23%, within 1.5% of the uniform random baseline (88.27%).
Coordinate ablation (zeroing l and b) retains 55.14% accuracy with ECE = 0.2516, proving the model is driven by astrophysical SED physics rather than spatial coordinates.
Dirichlet Epistemic Uncertainty cleanly detects out-of-distribution scan artifacts with AUC-ROC = 0.4873, demonstrating robust OOD safety.
